name: Birla Cotsyn (India) Limited
about: Birla Cotsyn (India) Limited manufactures and sells cotton ring spun yarn, open end yarn, and synthetic blended yarn in India. The company offers ring spinning cotton yarns, weaving and knitting yarns, and ring spinning dyed yarns. It is also involved in grey; dyeing solid griddles; fancy; weaving grey fabrics; ginning and pressing cotton bales; and fabric trading activities. The company also exports its products internationally. Birla Cotsyn (India) Limited was founded in 1932 and is based in Mumbai, India.
